cohort: The study included 15,551 women from the Nurses' Health Study and 7,397 men from the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study, all of whom provided detailed dietary data before blood draw and were free of diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or cancer at the time of blood draw.
finding: Coffee consumption was associated with favorable profiles of numerous plasma biomarkers in key metabolic and inflammatory pathways, including lower concentrations of C-peptide, leptin, CRP, and IL-6, and higher concentrations of SHBG and total adiponectin.
